name: cyclone_base_j
description: Cyclone's base loop with junction corners: 72 slots, no docks

provenance.config: n=144, m=144, x=m/2=72 traps; 144 data + 72 ancilla ions
provenance.note: capacity 4 = 2 data + 1 ancilla + 1 slot of rebalance headroom; Cyclone's own §4.1 puts 0..2n/m gates per trap per step

loops.note: the rigid-rotation orbit; one movement template shifts every ion on it

trap.note: general-purpose trap: gate, measure and cool all available

extra.note: one ion of the pair joins the neighbouring chain
the other splits back out; which one realizes the transposition
one ion, one trap to the next; the lowest common denominator move

wiring.note: O(1) DACs: Cyclone's headline wiring claim

curve.label: move, one shuttling zone; quanta borrowed from Jones
t8-t9 split and merge -- 60x a shuttle in heating
split; quanta borrowed from Jones (Cyclone charges none)

2.label: L-junction; superseded by R18, a bend is not a junction

3.label: degree-3 junction crossing; quanta borrowed from Jones
~200 us one-way measured: 85 round trips in ~34 ms

4.label: X-junction crossing; quanta borrowed from Jones
Jones gives no degree-4 figure; Cyclone's is carried over

gate_swap.note: 3 CX, distance-independent; R14's hidden cost of splitting off-edge

ms_gate.chain_note: G1: laser-intensity instability grows with chain length as A ~ N/ln N (Murali et al., ISCA 2020). The value is the reference chain length at which fidelity_at_n0 and error_vs_quanta were measured -- 2, from a two-ion gate zone.
ms_gate.note: 1.84e-3 two-qubit infidelity measured on H2 (2305.03828). max_quanta is R7's gate budget; PLAN §0.4 puts it at 1-2 quanta, 1.0 is the strict end

cool.note: Doppler sheet beams cover the whole trap, so one cooling operation cools every ion: it costs schedule time but does not serialize per ion (R7c)

heating.note: R17: ndot = S_E(w) e^2 / 4 m hbar w, accruing whether or not the ion moves. Device-specific and unmeasured for the target trap -- q_heating_rate_measurement

sort_merge.note: one ion of the pair joins the neighbouring chain

sort_split.note: the other splits back out; which one realizes the transposition

shuttle.note: one ion, one trap to the next; the lowest common denominator move
